description: Dependency updates for devsweep: the Rust crate and the GitHub Actions workflows.

Renovate merges, not GitHub (platformAutomerge: false). Native auto-merge lands every ready PR at the same instant, and two PRs that both touch Cargo.lock would conflict. Renovate merges one branch per run, always rebased on main.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Non-major dev-dependencies merge on their own: they only run in the test suite, so when they break, they break CI and not the binary users install
Only patches of runtime crates merge on their own, behind the `check` job (fmt, clippy, the whole suite with its insta snapshots, and the release build for both targets)
Runtime minors go into a single PR, for review
Cargo treats a 0.x minor as a breaking release (0.29 -> 0.30 is not compatible), but Renovate labels it `minor`. Handle it like a major: its own PR, never merged on its own
GitHub Actions go into one PR and are never merged on their own: release.yml only runs when a release is published, so a green CI does not prove the release still works
A major never merges on its own, in any manager

ratatui drives the terminal through crossterm and only supports specific crossterm versions (0.30 pairs with 0.29). They move together and always with review: the snapshots cover rendering, not the real terminal
